newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus stocks show signs of recovery.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus stocks show signs of recovery.

text.p: Cyprus stocks began showing signs of recovery in mid-week trading on Wednesday, making gains of 2.01 percent since Friday.
The 41-share Cyprus Stock Exchange (CSE) general index, which is set at 100 points, closed at 83.88 on Wednesday from Friday's closing figure of 81.56.
Banking stocks made considerable gains. The banking sub-index closed at 91.41, making gains of 3.17 percent from its 88.60 close on Friday.
Fully paid shares of the Bank of Cyprus closed at 348.5 from 339.5 on Friday. Fully paid shares in the Cyprus Popular Bank closed at 323.5, up 11.5 cents from 312 on Friday.
Hellenic Bank fully paid shares closed at 252 from from 250 on Friday.
The tourist company sub-index closed at 75.82 from 75.32 on Friday, and the insurance company sub-index closed at 62.74 from 61.50 on Friday.
Universal Life Insurance closed unchanged at 384.5. Paneuropean Insurance, closed higher at 140.5 from 136.5 on Friday.
